description: Style lint. Any text in, URL-encoded as the text query parameter (up to 12,000 bytes), a style scorecard out: nine rules (actually filler, sentence-initial Most, ten LLM tell phrases, not-X-but-Y contrast, em dashes, curly quotes, exclamations, repeated words, double spaces), every hit counted with line numbers, a tell/typography/rhythm summary, the rule table beside the verdict. Price: $0.005 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

text.description: The text to lint (up to 12,000 bytes).

name: style-lint
